sketches.mechanism: A forward-declared struct is an incomplete type: it may be named, but no object of it can be instantiated until its body is defined.
sketches.resonance: A self can be declared before it can take up space.

sketches.mechanism: A limited type cannot be copied or assigned, so initialization of one object from another is rejected by the type system.
sketches.resonance: A promise may be made, but it cannot be duplicated into another life.

sketches.mechanism: Receiving from a nil channel blocks forever because no sender can ever rendezvous with it.
sketches.resonance: Waiting for an unopened way to answer becomes an endless vigil.
